description: The Science Data Bank page describes benchmark results for burst and leakage failure estimation of corroded gas and oil pipeline segments. The metadata identify Monte Carlo simulation and a CSA limit-state function. The provider is Science Data Bank depositor, creator not exposed in retrieved page. Coverage: Coverage concerns simulated corrosion defects, not a geographically identified pipeline inventory. No observation period, defect-sampling interval or coordinate resolution is established. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The page exposes a short metadata description but no readable body. Large computational counts and reliability claims were not checked, and are not adopted as established evidence. For simulation it may support surrogate-model training and comparison with probabilistic pipeline-failure calculations. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
